sn2.26:1.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho rohitasso devaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
sn2.26:1.3: yattha nu kho bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati sakkā nu kho so bhante gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vāti.
sn2.26:1.4: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmīti.
sn2.26:2.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmīti.
sn2.26:3.1: bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante, rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ bhojaputto iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo.
sn2.26:3.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpo javo ahosi: seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammā dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katayoggo katūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasireneva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
sn2.26:3.3: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi: seyyathāpi nāma puratthimasamuddā pacchimo samuddo.
sn2.26:3.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, evarūpaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji:
sn2.26:3.6: so khvāhaṃ bhante evarūpena javena samannāgato evarūpena ca padavītihārena aññatreva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā va lokassa antaṃ antarāva kālakato.
sn2.26:4.3: “yattha kho āvuso na jāyati, na jīyati, na mīyati, na cavati, na uppajjati, nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmī”ti.
sn2.26:5.1: na kho panāhaṃ āvuso, appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
sn2.26:5.2: api cāhaṃ āvuso imasmiññeva byāmamatte kalebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañca paññāpemi, lokasamudayañca lokanirodhañca lokanirodhagāminiñca paṭipadanti.
